why: Lets `unlockedByClosing` promise that closing an issue makes a downstream issue ready when that downstream issue still has blockers nobody read. `immediate` exists precisely to be the honest half of the pair -- `downstream` is reach, `immediate` is the claim a maintainer acts on -- so an overcount here is worse than no number at all. The same unknown-is-never-ready rule as the first entry, at the level where it turns into advice.
killedBy: frontier: what closing an issue would unlock does not count an issue whose remaining blocker is merely unread
